scope: UKS additional existing-group references through bounded local matching
initial_selection: exact v1 ascending-group-ID greedy selection on original raw occurrences
improvement: replace one added group reference with two unused existing groups when remaining occurrence capacities permit
constraints: at most one reference per group per owner; original references locked; preserve exact expanded neighbor multiset
guarantee: each owner's number of group references is at least the v1 greedy count; no maximum matching claim
retained_unit_order: original units except consumed earliest raw occurrences, followed by added groups in ascending ID
validation: full independent multigraph validation, original reference retention and per-owner v1 count lower bound
